text:
Aisha (Sales): Quick warm handoff for Foresight — signed E3 pilot (4 GPU nodes). Onboarding started; kickoff scheduled but blockers: SSO metadata pending, large dataset ingestion behavior unclear, and they asked for a Private deployment evaluation. Renewal is ~11 months out; expansion likely if pilot goes well. @Diego can you own onboarding and enablement follow-ups?

Diego (CS): Got it, I can own. I'll schedule the kickoff and run the enablement. Need IdP metadata and a sample dataset manifest. ETA for SSO setup once we have metadata: ~3 business days.

Aisha (Sales): Sent IdP metadata to Emma today (she's the primary contact). SP metadata endpoint: https://idp.foresight.ai/metadata.xml. Note: they plan to upload via UI CSV upload (~120GB). Also logging request: they mentioned intermittent 502s during a dry run.

Nora (Support): Thanks. Can you ask them for the diagnostic bundle and any request IDs? I'll open a support ticket. 502s during large CSV uploads often point to proxy timeouts or chunking issues.

Sam (Eng Lead): @Nora please include sample request IDs and the `upload_worker` logs. If it's a proxy timeout we can adjust, but large single-file uploads tend to backpressure KV cache. We should check memory spikes.

Aisha (Sales): Emma's contact: emma@foresight.ai. Pilot dataset is ~120GB, CSV with ~10M rows. They also requested examples of prompt templates and a named-entity reranker.

Diego (CS): Proposed next steps (owners):
1) Kickoff call + calendar invite (Diego)
2) Get IdP metadata & confirm SSO flow (Aisha)
3) Support collects logs + diag bundle (Nora, ticket created)
4) Eng triage for 502s & propose mitigation (Sam)
5) Enablement session + prompt templates after stable ingestion (Diego/Maya)
I'll send a Mon 10am PT invite — pls confirm availability.

Nora (Support): Created ticket SUP-4872 and asked Emma for diagnostic bundle. She uploaded bundle to our uploads: s3://redwood-uploads/foresight/diag-1965432100.zip. Waiting on request IDs & timestamps.

Sam (Eng Lead): Found a spike in `upload_worker` around 2025-08-10T15:22:00Z in the uploaded bundle. Pattern looks like backpressure from KV cache leading to request timeouts. Quick mitigation: enable stream-chunking for large CSVs (server-side) and bump proxy timeout from 60s -> 180s for the trial env. I'll prepare a small rollout plan.

Diego (CS): Sounds good. @Nora please paste the SUP ticket link into the kickoff invite so Emma can join directly. I'll coordinate the low-traffic window for the chunking rollout tomorrow.

Aisha (Sales): Also logging feature requests/feedback: they want curated prompt templates for financial summarization and a named-entity reranker example. Captured as FR-129. Add to product feedback tracker.

Maya (CS Manager): Noted for renewal playbook: add an enablement session, perf benchmark report, and a follow-up QBR 6 weeks post-rollout. Renewal risk low but expansion opportunity — classify as "growth".

oncall-bot: Deploy succeeded: platform/proxy v1.18.2 → us-west-2 at 1965432160

Diego (CS): Thanks everyone — keeping this as the single source of truth. I'll post meeting notes and an action-item checklist after the kickoff.

Aisha (Sales): Thanks team, I'll ping Emma to confirm Mon 10am PT and ask for any additional upload details. :thumbsup:

Nora (Support): I'll follow up with SUP-4872 updates in this thread.

Sam (Eng Lead): If we enable chunking, we'll also provide a short how-to for their engineering team (code snippet + curl example).
